To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the online pruning strategy can reduce the network complexity without compromising the performance and (ii) the proposed hybrid network can achieve better performance than FAM or FAMDDA in some cases, while it is comparable to them in other cases.

FAMDDaT and FAM-T, which are two constructive neural network systems that have a pruning capability, have the ability to yield satisfactory classification performance, with the advantage that the networks have a parsimonious structure.
FAM-T and the FAMDDA are able to reduce the network complexity online, while maintaining good classification performance, which makes it suitable for online applications.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of an online pruning strategy for two constructive neural networks and its application in the fault detection and diagnosis of a power plant.
the development of online pruning strategies to constructively build ANNs with the capability of reducing network complexity online.

the development of a novel pruning strategy that can be applied in an online manner to reduce network complexity, and it can be used to construct FAM-T and/or FAMDDA- T networks for solving classification tasks.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
FAM-T and, especially, FAMDDA- T are able to provide an effective and efficient solution for the classification problems.
FAM-T is more appropriate than FAMDDA for classification problems, whereas FAMDDA is more suitable for prediction problems.

FAM-T and, in particular, FAMDDA with the temporary node pruning strategy are very promising in solving classification problems, and the proposed strategy could be a useful alternative in designing and constructing neural networks.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
FAM-T and especially FAMDDA- T are promising alternatives for supervised ANN learning.

the proposed pruning strategy can be used to reduce the number of nodes in a network and improve its generalisation ability, and the resulting hybrid network can be applied to a wide range of applications.
FAMDDAs with temporary nodes can be used for classification problems in real-world applications.
The main takeaway from our work is that
FAM and FARMDDA can be used for solving classification problems with a small number of classes and a large number of attributes.
the pruning strategy can be used in conjunction with the FAM and FAMA-DDA algorithms to achieve better classification accuracy, while reducing the network size.
, for the given task, FAM-T and/or FAMDDA- T can be considered as the first choice of ANN models.
